## Task: Set up frontend build pipeline (Vite + React) ## Step: execute Create frontend build infrastructure in a web/ directory at project root. 1. Create web/package.json: { "name": "@harms-haus/engin-web", "private": true, "type": "module", "scripts": { "dev": "vite", "build": "vite build" }, "dependencies": { "react": "^19.0.0", "react-dom": "^19.0.0", "@tanstack/react-virtual": "^3.0.0" }, "devDependencies": { "@types/react": "^19.0.0", "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0", "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.0.0", "typescript": "^5.8.0", "vite": "^6.0.0" } } 2. Create web/vite.config.ts: import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], root: '.', build: { outDir: 'dist', emptyOutDir: true, sourcemap: true }, server: { proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:3619', '/ws': { target: 'ws://localhost:3619', ws: true } } } }); 3. Create web/tsconfig.json: { "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES2024", "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "jsx": "react-jsx", "strict": true, "esModuleInterop": true, "skipLibCheck": true, "resolveJsonModule": true, "isolatedModules": true, "noEmit": true }, "include": ["src"] } 4. Create web/index.html: engin
The {{WS_ENDPOINT}} placeholder is replaced at serve-time by the Bun server (T05). In dev mode the proxy handles WebSocket forwarding. 5. Add to root package.json scripts: "build:web": "cd web && bun install && bun run build" 6. Create web/src/ directory with a placeholder web/src/main.tsx: console.log('engin web loading') 7. Run cd web && bun install && bun run build to verify it works. Verification: bun run build:web from root succeeds and produces web/dist/index.html. ## Relevant Files web/package.json web/vite.config.ts web/tsconfig.json web/index.html package.json
